findings.description: The new `params` argument is never forwarded to `self.request`, so GET query parameters are silently discarded.
findings.rationale: Calling `session.get(url, params={"page": 2})` now binds the value to the explicit `params` parameter instead of leaving it in `kwargs`. Because the request call only forwards `kwargs`, the server receives no `page` query parameter, potentially returning incorrect results. Positional parameters are also discarded.
